Named limits: Philosopher's Stone gives no Strength to spawned monsters; battle-start order is list order. Newly writable on Effect::Heal: Blood Vial, Bird-Faced Urn, Pantograph.

Potions: 31 of 33 load from content/packs/act1-potions.json, each against its decompiled class (engine/tests/act1_potions.rs, fight_vocabulary.rs, act1_singles.rs, discovery.rs); Attack, Skill and Power Potion discover 1 of 3 random cards of their type from the Ironclad pool (a pack's pools, Discover; docs/specs/discovery.md), free this turn, Skills 25 of 28 and Powers 12 of 14 in the pool (the blocked Ironclad cards); Distilled Chaos plays the top 3 cards (PlayTop, CombatState.top_queue; the same effect loads the Ironclad card Havoc); Art of War and Pocketwatch keep last turn's count in the relic counter; Liquid Memories returns a card that costs 0 this turn (CombatState.free_in_hand, docs/specs/act1-singles.md; mark_free_in_hand for discovery); Fairy in a Bottle is a potion with "trigger": "OwnerDied", never drunk, used before Lizard Tail; Smoke Bomb escapes a hallway or elite fight: it ends as won with CombatState.escaped (CombatWon hooks and the combat-end heal run; docs/specs/act1-singles.md section 4), not a legal action in a boss fight (a slot holds a boss kind, or the boss_fight mark set by give_potions survives Slime Boss's split); Entropic Brew fills every empty potion slot with a random potion of its pack's potions less Fruit Juice, one chance event per slot, 65/25/10 by rarity then alike (ObtainRandomPotions; docs/specs/act1-singles.md section 5), its pool's potions bound with it (their pack powers and discoveries' cards: 40 card slots since, CARD_SLOTS), and a boss fight holding it carries the boss_fight mark; potion slots are 3 plus each held relic's potion_slots (Potion Belt 2); left out: Colorless Potion (colorless cards: none of the game's 34 loads), Snecko Oil (C5 with chance); the run layer holds no potions yet (P2).
